redaction: aggregate-only; tenant IDs, request IDs, and payloads omitted

repeated_sequence_groups.interpretation: historical residue in the retained production population; not evidence of an active writer after 2026-08-14

sequence_gap_rows.interpretation: co-located with the historical repeated-sequence residue

negative_latency_rows.interpretation: historical future-dated enqueued_at values; writer must refuse sealing a row before its enqueue timestamp

head_tail_mismatches.interpretation: active verifier/resume hazard for two retained partitions; do not auto-repair or rewrite production rows

source_remediation.ambiguous_tail: Read two sealed-tail candidates and fail closed when the maximum sequence occurs more than once; LIMIT 1 was nondeterministic on a duplicate tail.
source_remediation.future_seal: The bounded JSON1 UPDATE now requires every pending row's enqueued_at <= the batch sealed_at timestamp.
source_remediation.sequence_collision: Reject duplicate sequence numbers in one chunk and reject collisions with another already-sealed row in the same partition before returning success.

remaining_operator_action: After deploy, re-run aggregate duplicate/gap/head-tail/negative-latency controls. Historical rows require an explicit offline repair decision; the drain must remain fail-closed until then.
